Game Overview

Warrior vs. Skulls puts players into a sword experience centered on battle your way through swarming skulls as a brave warrior, collecting coins to boost health. Strategically choose to dash past or strike quickly in this fast-paced action adventure. Master your agility and strike speed to reach the ultimate goal while keeping the perilous skulls at bay.
